description: Fat-depot map layers for the interactive body map. Male/female (or dual-layer) patterns. Do not reinvent 3D viewers — inject as panel/hover payloads (see notes/github-anatomy-landscape.md).
viewer_note: Prefer ashemag/human-atlas or slorksmo/Human-Atlas; our job is payloads only.

shared.summary: Largest everyday archive under the belly wall — same chemistry as other white fat, different neighbors than visceral pads.

male.summary: Men more often expand this abdominal under-skin belt alongside visceral pads — the classic upper-body pattern.

female.summary: Premenopausal women usually keep more of their surplus in hips/thighs; this belly wall store grows more after estrogen falls.

shared.summary: Smaller volume than under-skin fat, but drains toward the liver via the portal vein — a busy, leakier account.

male.summary: On average men carry a higher visceral share for a given body size; androgens and android patterning play into this.

female.summary: Premenopause: relatively less visceral fat. After estrogen drops, visceral share often climbs toward a more central pattern.

shared.summary: A long-term deposit under the skin of hips, buttocks, and thighs — often metabolically quieter than visceral fat.

male.summary: Present in everyone; typically a smaller fraction of total fat than in premenopausal women.

female.summary: Estrogen helps steer storage here during reproductive years — the classic pear-shaped lower-body pattern.

shared.summary: Adult brown/beige activity shows up on PET near neck and collarbones in the cold — fuel burned as heat, not archived.

male.summary: Detectable in many adult men on cold exposure; amount varies widely with age, leanness, and outdoor habits.

female.summary: Also present in women; sex differences exist in studies but the map job is the same — show the heat layer when active.

shared.summary: A thin specialized depot on the heart surface — keep it distinct from belly visceral fat in the UI.
Deep pad beside the kidneys — map as visceral-adjacent, not the under-skin belly belt.

sex_toggle.dual_note: Show dual-layer or toggle; android (central) vs gynoid (gluteofemoral) is the main story.
